source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Complete and keep the North Carolina Incident Report Form and a copy of the First Aid medical treatment record from the attending health care provider on file with a copy provided to the injured worker. *The North Carolina Incident Report Form must be generated from the Docusign web site using your school email address. (NCIRF - link) The link to the template can be requested at aacmhelp@unc.edu.
3. Obtain a completed First Aid evaluation form after minor injuries are treated. *The North Carolina Incident Report Form must be generated from the Docusign web site using your school email address. (NCIRF - link) The link to the template can be requested at aacmhelp@unc.edu. Provide a copy to the employee. It does not need to be submitted to the Safety Coordinator.
4. If the employee goes to Urgent Care, the clinic should generate and provide the First Aid documentation to the employee as
